name: Empyrean Ruins (11.3S, 37.6E)
title: 11.3S, 37.6E - Empyrean Ruins
summary: A compact Empyrean ruin field in a valley floor west of Yanshi: a low stone platform with the Abandoned Arena portal, the Colosseum portal, three moss-brick portal arches (Riverbend, North Desert Edge, Desert Ridge Border) and a ring of ten Empyrean statues, between hills.

landmarks.name: Platform with the Abandoned Arena portal
Riverbend portal arch
landmarks.note: Moss-brick arch 0x02000395 with the portal under it.

landmarks.name: Empyrean statues
landmarks.note: Ten 0x02000397 statues in a ring 13-30 m around the platform.

site.name: Empyrean Ruins (11.3S, 37.6E)
site.notes: Teleport = gazetteer the-colosseum-portal (outdoor, beside the platform). [critic b4-7 2026-10-15: teleport changed from '@teleloc 0xAE710014 69.4794 74.5075 20 0.026548 0 0 0.999648' because the gazetteer the-colosseum-portal drop is the Colosseum portal itself (0.0 m, weenieType Portal): a hidden player there would be ported away. Derived drop 8 m east on flat ground, 8.0 m from the Colosseum portal, 6.8 m from any drawn object. Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Cross the Empyrean ruin field north-north-west 20 m above the Abandoned Arena platform with the gimbal tracking through vertical; stay 16 m above the portal arches and statues.
shots.notes: Pass over the ruin field: the platform with the Abandoned Arena portal, the Colosseum portal and three moss-brick portal arches (Riverbend, North Desert Edge, Desert Ridge Border) inside a ring of ten Empyrean statues; flying away from the south-south-east sun so the faces are lit, five portal swirls in frame at the crossing. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-10 s: AGL 21.53..22 m, nearest drawn 16.05 m (static 0xAE71#11 0x02000395), vmax 4.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/41, subject in frame 100%; edit 1.8-8.3 s: AGL 21.88..22 m, nearest drawn 16.48 m (spawn Abandoned Arena), vmax 4.5 m/s, LOS blocked 0/26, subject in frame 100%; flight cinema peak 4.51 m/s (cap 12), max tracking gap 0.02 m.

shots.standingOrder: Hold 1.8 m up north of the ruins with an Empyrean statue 14.5 m ahead in focus, then pull focus to the Riverbend portal under its moss-brick arch 26 m away; stay 3.7 m from the platform.
shots.notes: Backlit portal swirl: looking south-south-east toward the high sun, a statue sits soft in the foreground until the focus pull (t 4 s) lands on the Riverbend portal under its moss-brick arch on the right third. Verified (check.mjs, full take flown): take 0-8 s: AGL 1.84..1.9 m, nearest drawn 3.72 m (static 0xAE71#13 0x01000F67), vmax 0.06 m/s, LOS blocked 0/33, subject in frame 100%; edit 1.2-6.7 s: AGL 1.84..1.9 m, nearest drawn 3.73 m (static 0xAE71#13 0x01000F67), vmax 0.06 m/s, LOS blocked 0/22, subject in frame 100%.

shots.standingOrder: Hang 55 m straight above the Abandoned Arena platform and turn the image 40 degrees clockwise; the lens never moves and nothing is within 50 m.
shots.notes: Graphic nadir over the ruin field: five portal swirls and ten statues around the platform turn like a dial (pitch -88 so the portal particles do not spin at exact nadir).
